order_assignment: One unseeded SystemRandom shuffle before any inference; no resampling.

decision.hypothesis: Key question: has increasing bending viscosity from the earlier matched values to 2e-4 N m^2 s entered a slow-relaxation regime, so that more viscosity cannot satisfy the loaded settling qualifications while preserving the required localized displacement? Mathematical/physical evidence: F4 has a qualified contact-free unloaded hard equilibrium (KKT, LICQ, strict complementarity and second-order sufficiency), but its only finite-load observation covers s3_positive and fails loaded tip-speed, monitor-speed and qvel checks; the reported normalized static-balance residual is also 0.4529 and the task result is incomplete. Working hypothesis: the remaining failure is not evidence for inadequate damping alone; it is a damping–relaxation tradeoff, and the next useful route is a read-only matched comparison of F2/F3/F4 saved responses before any new candidate is generated. If residual and speed improved monotonically through F4, retain viscosity as a design variable and broaden finite-load screening; if improvement saturated or reversed, revise routing/material distribution rather than increasing viscosity again.
decision.expected_observation: A matched saved-response trend across F2, F3 and F4 will show whether loaded-window tip speed, monitor speed, qvel, static-balance residual and tail drift continue to decrease at 2e-4 viscosity without degrading the measured point/tip displacement constraints. Continued monotone improvement would support a bounded viscosity-focused revision followed by multi-load finite-time screening; saturation or reversal would support changing routing or spatial material distribution.
decision.weakening_observation: The hypothesis is weakened if F4 clearly improves every loaded settling metric relative to F3 while retaining displacement margins, or if the saved records are not comparable in candidate structure, load, sampling, or protocol. It is also weakened if the dominant failure is instead tendon length/capacity, contact, lateral-plane motion, or displacement localization rather than settling dynamics.
decision.fixed_conditions: Keep the frozen passive task, gravity, ten load definitions, original bounds and qualifications, no active control, candidate lineage geometry/routing/payout except for the already recorded viscosity changes, and compare only saved matched s3_positive finite-time observations. This diagnosis does not establish performance for the nine unmeasured load cases, every-step qualification, independent numerical confirmation, or task acceptance.
decision.stopping_condition: End the diagnosis once the comparable saved F2/F3/F4 loaded-window metrics and displacement components are tabulated and the trend is classified as monotone improvement, saturation/reversal, or non-comparable. Do not infer an ordinary gradient, structural descent, global causality, or acceptance.
decision.interpretation: Concrete proposed action: perform a read-only candidate-bound diagnosis of archived matched viscosity responses and choose between (A) a bounded viscosity-centered design revision plus broader load screening, or (B) a routing/material-distribution revision. Evidence scope is local and diagnostic: the current finite-load record is sampled s3_positive native physics only; hard-equilibrium mathematics does not transfer to dynamic success, and no independent full ten-case acceptance exists. Archived sources: C033–C035, especially C034 artifact 9654d899... and current candidate artifact 279ab69e....
